Ada Venn wartet, bis du näher kommst. Hi: Ada Venn waits until you come closer. No one here likes talking across a square.
Ada lässt die Gewichte sperren und führt: Ada has the weights locked away and keeps the refund list herself. Brack pays for the repair and gives you a dry supply chest for the barge, but her name stays out of the public record.
Ada schreibt Bracks Verantwortung und He: Ada writes Brack's responsibility and Hesper's exoneration side by side. The market gets a documented explanation, and you get your wage.
Ada setzt das Gewicht ab. „Ich erstatte:
Ada sets the weight down. "I'll refund the buyers the difference. But does Brack's name go into the public record, or only the faulty repair?"

You can assign the mistake openly or let Brack quietly make amends.
Adas Eichgewichte werden täglich leichte: Ada's calibration weights grow lighter every day. Hesper and Brack had access, but neither a rumour nor a curse replaces a weighing test.
Am Rand des Watts führt eine grünliche T: At the edge of the flats a greenish trail of drops leads to Jorin's way home. There is no second set of footprints.
Am nächsten Abend summt jemand beim Netz: The next evening someone hums the first line while hauling in nets. Brack has the little bell hung on the barge and pays for the three trips.
An einer Wurzel hängen drei ausgewaschen: Three washed-out tablets hang from a root: Linnet, Lio and Lin. Only the last bears a yellow loop with three knots. You don't untie the loop. The name should keep a way back.
Arven war dein Bruder. Warum benutzt du: Arven was your brother. Why do you use his picture?
Auf deinem neuen Steckbrief habe ich ein: On my new wanted poster I have a different nose.
Auf dem Reparaturzettel wurde „Bleifüllu: On the repair slip "lead filling" has been crossed out and "salt, only until Monday" added. The collection day falls before Monday.
Keep them as a relief fund.
Both bearing marks are still standing.
Beim Ausruhen zusätzlich 5 Unruhe abbaue: Shed an extra 5 unrest when resting; no extra effect for non-Beyonders.
Beim Trinken von Moortee im Kahn zusätzl: When drinking moor tea in the barge, regenerate an extra 10 nerves, capped at the maximum; the tea is used up as usual.
Beim Verzehr eines Salzbrots im Kahn zus: When eating salt bread in the barge, regenerate an extra 3 nerves, capped at the maximum; the bread is used up as usual.
Pay Ruprecht Lamm for the help.
Bleib am Zeichentisch. Ich brauche einen: Stay at the drawing table. I need an ally.
Brack hat Oles alte Notenzeile aufgeschr:
Brack has written down Ole's old line of music. The three bars fill its gaps.

"When no window knows you any more,
when your name burns low and sore,
keep the place where people wait
till a boat comes home, however late.
Do not set the bowl aside.
One more comes. Give them time."

In the margin it says: "No magic. Just something one shouldn't unlearn."
Brack hat Salz statt des fehlenden Bleis: Brack used salt instead of the missing lead as a temporary filling and returned the weights too early.
Brack legt das Netz beiseite. „Ich hätte: Brack puts the net aside. "I should have kept them until proper lead arrived. Instead I cut off the warning thread. From the outside, haste looks exactly like intent."
Brack legt eine kleine Messingglocke auf:
Brack places a small brass bell on the bollard. "Ole wants the children to learn it. The families of the missing may just want to listen in peace."

The verses belong to no one. You can still give someone their first performance.
Das Dach hält. Wohin kommen die beiden t: The roof holds. Where do the two dry mats go?
Das Kind erinnert sich an zwei Töne sein: The child remembers two sounds of its mother: "Li" and a closing hum like an N.
Das Lied vom freien Platz: The Song of the Empty Place
Das Moor deckt ein Dach ab. Was schuldet: The moor is stripping a roof. What does the house owe it?
Das Moor nimmt das Reet eines Hauses zur: The moor takes back the thatch of a house whose name tablet is missing.
Das Original verborgen halten. Zuerst di: Keep the original hidden. Protect the people first.
Das Wasser selbst ist unauffällig; erst: The water itself is unremarkable; only Jorin's added lens salt makes the residues active in the dark.
Den Namen privat lassen und nur das Zeic: Keep the name private and carry only the token.
Den Weg decken, ohne einen Anteil zu ver: Cover the route without asking for a share.
Den belegten Schmuggel schriftlich melde: Report the proven smuggling in writing.
Den langen Hinterweg nehmen. (3 Nerven): Take the long back way. (3 nerves)
Der Pfandzettel unter dem Krug: The pawn ticket under the jug
Der Reetdecker will „Haus am warmen Grab:
The thatcher wants to keep "House by the Warm Ditch". Together you carve the words, fasten the tablet and let a single bundle slide into the water. At first light the rest of the thatch is still on the roof.

The thatcher has two dry mats left over. "For your barge, or for the neighbour? I can't promise both. Tell Sedge, she'll take them over."
Der frühere Leuchtturmwärter lebt verste: The former lighthouse keeper lives in hiding on the salt flats. His old bearings could show a second path to the island.
Die Abschriften verschwinden in Mantelta: The copies disappear into coat pockets. No one sings, but a woman moves over a little on her bench.
Die Fracht und Druces Zahlungen passen z: The cargo and Druce's payments fit a supply route of the Lightless. He is involved, but these boats deliver no strangers to the Lamp Office.
Die Kerbe am Türbalken: The notch in the door beam
Die Lichtlosen umgehen das Ölmonopol und: The Lightless get around the oil monopoly and pay Druce for unregistered passages.
The mats arrive before the rain. Sedge sends word: "A roof is no crime. Just don't forget who hasn't got one."
Die Salzfüllung erklärt den Verlust. Bei: The salt filling explains the loss. I have both statements.
Die Suche beenden und den Wunsch respekt: End the search and respect the wish.
Die beiden alten Wartungsmarken im Salzw: The two old maintenance markers on the salt flats still stand in the line given on Rinn's plan.
Die geöffnete Kiste enthält Decken und L: The opened crate contains blankets and lamp wicks. Under the lid is the black match sign of the Lightless.
Die grüne Boje liegt außerhalb des Later: The green buoy lies outside the lantern light. You row over and hear three dull notes through the wood of the boat. Beneath the rim of algae you read "knows you any more". At the jetty you tie the boat up again.
Die kurze Fahrt endet unter einer nassen: The short trip ends under a wet blanket of fog. Druce pays out your one-time share, and now you know how quickly a favour becomes income.
Die reine Probe bleibt dunkel. Nur das m: The pure sample stays dark. Only the waste water mixed with lens salt forms small drops that follow the glass.
Die weiße Füllung löst sich im feuchten: The white filling dissolves in the damp cloth. A solid control weight does not change.
Die zweite Marke trägt zwei Kerben und e: The second marker bears two notches and an arrow towards the island side. Fresh shell fragments show that the stone ridge beneath is still being washed clear.
Drei Durchfahrten stehen am Rand des Nac: Three passages are noted in the margin of the night book. Each is paid, none registered with customs. Instead of a name, Druce has drawn a black match.
Drei Fahrten ohne Laterne, drei kleine Z: Three trips without a lantern, three small payments. Druce notes the sign of the Lightless instead of a sender.
Drei Hafenbojen bewahren die Takte eines: Three harbour buoys preserve the bars of an old homecoming song, even though their bells are silent.
Druce folds the envelope once too often. "Just messages, nothing more. The best part is that she writes her own bills again."
Druce legt die Hand auf das Rad. „Weil e:
Druce lays his hand on the wheel. "Because a light attracts certain things. And because not every cargo belongs on a tax slip."

"Look in the night book and check the crate at the lower jetty. Then tell me whether you've helped people or lamps."
Druce lässt nachts unbeleuchtete Boote p: Druce lets unlit boats pass at night. Check the cargo before you turn darkness into a crime against people.
Druce streicht deinen Namen aus seiner p: Druce strikes your name from his private accounts. "Then you know where to find warmth." He gives you an invitation from the Lightless and bread for the road.
Druces unbeleuchtete Boote transportiere: Druce's unlit boats carry lamp wicks and warming blankets for the Lightless, not prisoners.
Du beobachtest die Tür statt deiner Prob: You're watching the door instead of your samples.
Du erkennst den Empfänger, aber vor dem: You recognise the recipient, but curious eyes watch the last open stretch. A fitting disguise makes the handover ordinary, a paid messenger makes it short. You can also take the long, dark back alley.
Du füllst klares Wasser in ein sauberes: You fill clear water into a clean glass. An older green trail of drops runs beside it towards the city, without footprints. Jorin's way home can be traced; his supposed pursuer cannot.
Du gibst eine sachliche Meldung am amtli: You drop a matter-of-fact report in the official letter box. Druce closes the sluice for the night, and a sealed reply contains the small informant's bonus.
Du hast nach deiner Befreiung eine Liste: After your release you wrote a list.
You had Ada's weights in your cupboard.
You're holding a lamp without a wick.
Du ruderst zur kleinen Boje hinter der S: You row to the small buoy behind the sandbank. Its bell has no clapper, yet the chain answers in the same rhythm. "Keep the place where people wait" stands inside the iron. You take the last line back with you.
Du ruderst zur roten Boje und legst die: You row to the red buoy and lay your hand on the iron. Two short jolts travel through the chain. The old casting reads "When no window", followed by a long pause. You return to the jetty.
Du setzt dich neben das Kind und fragst: You sit down next to the child and ask about a voice instead of a name. "Li," it says, then closes its lips into an N. It tugs at a yellow loop with three knots on its sleeve.
Du stellst die reine Probe neben Jorins: You place the pure sample next to Jorin's waste glass. Only a grain of his lens salt makes the clean water reach for the glass in the dark. Jorin whispers: "I examined the moor water and forgot my own ingredient."
Du unterschreibst die Verkaufserlaubnis,: You sign the sale permission, not the old pawn contract. Hesper pays out the agreed advance and pins the slip to your reply.
Eichmeisterin des Salzmarkts: Calibration master of the Salt Market
Ein Glasbecken und ein verschlossener Kr: A glass basin and a sealed jug stand on a narrow board.
Ein Kind ist aus dem Vergessmoor zurückg: A child has come back from the Forgetting Moor, but its name has not. Voice and knot sign can find it again if you take both seriously.
Ein Kind sitzt am Geländer und zählt die:
A child sits at the railing, counting its fingers over and over. "They still add up. But I don't know my name any more."

A yellow loop is sewn onto its sleeve. Mother Sedge brought the child back from the Forgetting Moor and asks you to find the lost address, not to put in just any name.
Ein Reetdecker sitzt auf seiner Leiter u:
A thatcher sits on his ladder, holding on to the last reed. "Every night I thatch the same roof. In the morning the thatch lies down in the water, neatly bundled, as if someone had knocked off work."

He shows you the empty notch above the door. "Mother Sedge calls that a forgotten address. Ask her before I send the house a bill."
Ein Reetdecker verliert jede Nacht sein: A thatcher loses his freshly laid roof every night. Mother Sedge knows a custom that gives houses back their address.
Ein Student hält sich für verfolgt. Mit: A student believes he is being followed. With an Academy robe and a real comparison sample you can test what is causing his fear.
Ein dichter Torfofen mit vernietetem Rau: A tight peat stove with a riveted flue replaces the draughty old cabin stove.
Take on a trip and earn a share.
Eine Wachstuchkarte mit zwei Peilstriche: An oilcloth map with two bearing lines lies on a folding table.
Eine alte Messingkassette ist in Kettleg: An old brass cash box has been deposited in Kettlegate. Your seal was used as a sender's mark, not as a new authority.
Eine geteilte Sonne ist in die landseiti: A divided sun is cut into the landward maintenance marker. Its gap points to the second marker, not directly at the tower.
Eine kleine Messingglocke hängt am Türba: A small brass bell hangs from the door beam; its clapper carries red yarn.
Eine neue Oberstadtauflage zeigt dein Ge: A new Upper Town print shows your face wrongly. The civilian draughtsman seems less surprised about it than relieved.
Eine salzfleckige Kiste steht unter dem: A salt-stained chest stands under the table on four short legs.
Einmalig beim ersten Kartenstudium 5 Ner: Regenerate 5 nerves once on first studying the map. No travel or combat bonuses.
Einmalig beim ersten Läuten 8 Nerven reg: Regenerate 8 nerves once on the first ring. After that only sound and reading text.
Einmalig nach dem Einbau 2 Salzbrote ent: Take out 2 salt breads once after installing it. No daily refill.
Entscheide bei Brack über die erste Weit: Decide with Brack how it is first passed on.
Decide with Hesper about the cash box.
Entscheide bei Sedge, wer die Matten bek: Decide with Sedge who gets the mats.
Entscheide mit Sedge und dem Kind über d: Decide on the name with Sedge and the child.
Entscheide, wer Rinns Originalplan bekom: Decide who should get Rinn's original plan.
Erneuere das Täfelchen und beobachte das: Renew the tablet and watch the roof.
Erste Wartungsmarke im Salzwatt: First maintenance marker on the salt flats
Frachtkiste am unteren Schleusensteg: Cargo crate at the lower sluice jetty
Ask Sedge for a house name.
Fundstelle im Vergessmoor: Find site in the Forgetting Moor
Halt den Platz, an dem man wartet: Keep the place where people wait
Hast du einen stumpfen Bleistift für mic: Do you have a blunt pencil for me?
Hesper legt zwei Antwortbögen hin. „Verw:
Hesper lays out two reply forms. "Have it kept or sell it. The conductor takes either, but only the first can be undone."

She offers you an advance for the sale permission. If you want to keep the cash box, she'll cover the remaining transport.
Hesper stellt den Krug ab. „Wenn ich Gäs:
Hesper puts the jug down. "If I cheat guests, I use smaller glasses. I don't hollow out brass blocks."

She shows you the dry cupboard and names the collection day.
Hesper versiegelt deine Antwort. „Ein pa: Hesper seals your reply. "Some things may wait until their owner has room for them again." She puts bread out for your way home.
Hesper zählt nicht nach. „Sie hat sogar: Hesper doesn't count it. "She even paid for the bread I ate myself. Tell her the next soup is on me."
Höre den erinnerten Ruf oder vereinbare: Listen to the remembered call or agree on a temporary name with Sedge.
Ich habe das ganze Lied gelesen. Wer sol: I've read the whole song. Who should hear it?
Ich habe den Namen anhand von Stimme und: I found the name by the voice and the loop.
Ich habe eine persönliche Lieferung von: I have a personal delivery from Tinder.
Ich kenne Fracht und Zahlungen. Wir müss: I know the cargo and the payments. We need to talk about the route.
I'll look for the two traces first.
Im Deckel des Kastens klebt Bracks Repar: Brack's repair slip is stuck inside the lid of the box. "Lead filling" is crossed out; beneath it says "salt, only until Monday". Ada already collected the weights on Saturday. The little sheet was never turned outward.
Im Hafen singen, damit es weitergegeben: Sing it in the harbour, so it gets passed on.
In der Glocke liegt ein Pfandzettel mit: In the Bell lies a pawn ticket with your old office seal. Someone in Kettlegate has kept something you thought was already lost.
In passender Verkleidung persönlich über: Hand it over in person, in a fitting disguise.
In unseren Kahn. Wir brauchen einen troc: Into our barge. We need a dry place.
Ivy hat eine beschlagnahmte Bürokassette: Ivy handed over a confiscated office cash box for safekeeping. The letter only confirms her own action, not the outcome of an old case.
Ivy hat meine Kassette verwahrt. Ich mus: Ivy kept my cash box. I have to reply.
Jorin Siel waits until you come closer. No one here likes talking across a square.
Jorin prüft den Saum deiner Akademierobe:
Jorin checks the hem of your Academy robe. "Since I started boiling the moor water, something wet follows me at night. When I stop, it keeps dripping behind me."

"Fetch a comparison sample from the salt flats and look at my waste container. Please, between colleagues. I won't let you near the experiments without a robe."
Jorin unterschreibt das Protokoll mit zi: Jorin signs the record with a shaking hand. Wyle has the teaching samples locked away and pays for your independent check.
Jorin verschließt den Abfallbehälter. „W:
Jorin locks the waste container. "Wyle has to learn about the mistake. But if you lay out the measurements with my name on them, I can forget my exams."

The samples will be sealed either way. You decide whether the failed experiment becomes public too.
Jorin wird von seinen verschütteten, mit: Jorin is being followed by his own spilled samples, activated with lens salt. The observation does not prove a general poisoning of the moor.
Jorins ungewaschene Probenflaschen hinte: Jorin's unwashed sample bottles leave the same glowing salt trail as the nightly pursuer.
Kann das Kind vorerst einen selbst gewäh: Can the child have a name it chose itself for now?
Kehre zu Zunder zurück und richte den Of: Return to Tinder and set up the stove.
Kein Halm ist gerissen. Die Reetbündel l: Not a single reed is torn. The thatch bundles lie with their cut ends towards the moor, and in the door beam sits the remnant of a washed-out tablet. It bears not a person's name, but: "House by the Warm Ditch".
Lamm versteckt den Umschlag im Besenstie: Lamm hides the envelope in his broom handle. "The blanket was inventory. Its return apparently too. I noticed nothing."
Read the sealed letter at the inn.
Lin drückt das Täfelchen selbst in den S: Lin presses the tablet into the shrine. "Now the house knows again whom to let in." Sedge pays for your careful search and adds some tea.
Lin offen am Schrein eintragen, mit Lins: Enter Lin openly at the shrine, with Lin's consent.
Lin steckt das Zeichen ein und sagt den: Lin pockets the token and says the name only to you. Sedge nods. "A quiet answer is an answer too."
Report, cover or take on a trip.
Nach der Sache den Fischern geben. Ein W: Give it to the fishermen afterwards. A path should help everyone.
Nach ihrer Befreiung bezahlt Zunder ihre: After her release Tinder pays her helpers. You carry three sealed envelopes through a city that is watching especially closely right now.
Neben dem Probedruck liegt ein abgegriff: Next to the proof print lies a worn memorial picture: "Arven Feder". The scar on his cheek is the same on every new wanted poster. It is missing from your old wanted sheet.
Nils Feder waits until you come closer. No one here likes talking across a square.
Nils deckt einen Versandbogen mit der Ha: Nils covers a dispatch sheet with his hand. "Today they're only searching at the gate. Have a drink and don't cross the avenue with shaking hands." He leaves you his emergency savings.
Nils holds the pencil the wrong way round. "The old station print is a good likeness. The new Upper Town print is mine. Sometimes a line gets tired when copied."

He glances at a proof print. "First check whom I drew instead of you. Then we'll talk about intent."
Nils markiert den Stapel mit „unbrauchba: Nils marks the stack "unusable". "An official mistake needs a stamp, not courage. Good thing I have a stamp."
Nils steckt dir seine private Korrekturl: Nils slips you his private correction list. "Ask for a blunt pencil. Then I'll know it's you."
Nils verändert die neue lokale Steckbrie: Nils alters the new local wanted-poster print after the picture of his late brother, to buy the living some time.
Nimm eine unbehandelte Probe im Salzwatt: Take an untreated sample on the salt flats.
Nur das Täfelchen „Lin“ trägt die gleich: Only the tablet "Lin" bears the same yellow loop with three knots as the child's sleeve.
Nur den wartenden Familien eine Abschrif: Give a copy only to the waiting families.
Nur die reparierten Messinggewichte verl: Only the repaired brass weights lose salt from their bases; the scales themselves are accurate.
Ole Tamsen erkennt in drei Bojen ein alt: Ole Tamsen recognises an old song in three buoys. Brack lends you a spare boat so you can find its missing lines.
Ole hört ein Lied in den Bojen. Kann ich: Ole hears a song in the buoys. Can I go out?
Oskar Rinn waits until you come closer. No one here likes talking across a square.
Pfandzettel mit deinem Büro-Siegel: Pawn ticket with your office seal
Check the weight and the repair slip.
Check the lab waste wearing the Academy robe.
Reparaturzettel im Gewichtskasten: Repair slip in the weight box
Rinn legt seinen Plan auf die Knie. „Der:
Rinn lays his plan on his knees. "The stone ridge only leads to beneath the island slope. Whoever waits up there remains your problem."

"You'll get the copy. But does the original go to the fishermen later, or does it stay with me until the people at the tower are safe?"
Rinn markiert auf dem Original die Namen: Rinn marks the names of the fishing families on the original. "So I have a duty roster after all." He gives you a copy and an old map table for the barge.
Rinn rollt das Original wieder ein. „Ein: Rinn rolls the original up again. "One secret fewer would have been nice. But one person fewer would be worse." You get the copy and money for supplies.
Rudere zur Boje 1 und notiere ihren Takt: Row to buoy 1 and note its rhythm.
Rudere zur Boje 2 und notiere ihren Takt: Row to buoy 2 and note its rhythm.
Rudere zur Boje 3 und notiere ihren Takt: Row to buoy 3 and note its rhythm.
Salz tritt aus Bracks unfertigen Reparat: Salt is leaking from Brack's unfinished repairs. Neither Hesper's cupboard nor a curse explains the specific loss of weight. Negligence is proven, deliberate fraud is not.
Sedge fährt mit dem Finger über deine Ab:
Sedge runs her finger over your copy. "A house here needs a name, otherwise the moor takes it for driftwood. Carve its address anew and give it back one bundle, without registering a person for it."

She lays a piece of wood in your lap. "It can be a new house name, too. Only the thatcher has to use it from now on."
Sedge liest „Lin“ leise vor. Das Kind ni:
Sedge reads "Lin" softly. The child nods the second time. "That's me. But does everyone outside have to hear it?"

Sedge holds out two pieces of wood: a name tablet for the shrine and a small token for the coat pocket.
Sedge nennt das Kind Spatz und stellt ei: Sedge calls the child Sparrow and sets down a bowl of soup. For keeping company she gives you a small wage; you did not bring back the lost name.
Sedge schiebt dir den Lohn zu. „Sie kann: Sedge slides the wage over to you. "She can take the blanket off her shoulders today. She'll notice."
Stille Nachbesserung, mit Erstattung an: Quiet amends, with refunds to all buyers.
Stimme und Knotenzeichen stimmen bei Lin: Voice and knot sign match for Lin. The name can be brought back from two traces without offering the moor someone else's name.
Türbalken im Torfstich: Door beam at the peat cutting
Unbeschädigte Bündel zeigen zum Moor. Am: Undamaged bundles point towards the moor. The tablet "House by the Warm Ditch" is missing from the beam.
Unter dem unbeschädigten Messingmantel s: Under the undamaged brass casing sits a white plug. On a damp cloth a salt bloom forms beneath it. Ada's control weight of solid iron stays unchanged on the same scales.
Unter der neuen Druckplatte liegt ein Tr: Under the new printing plate lies a memorial picture. Nose, scar and ears match the false wanted poster, not your face.
Unter einem Krug steckt ein Pfandzettel:
Under a jug lies a pawn ticket from Kettlegate. The imprint comes from your old office seal, but the signature is missing. On the back it says: "To the traveller from Kettlegate, in person only."

Hesper must know who is leaving something here for you.
Unter einer Lage grober Dochte liegen tr: Under a layer of coarse wicks lie dry blankets, no shackles and no person. The sender has put the black match sign of the Lightless under the lid. The oil monopoly turns warmth into contraband.
Examine the empty notch in the door beam.
Verbinde Fracht und bezahlte Durchfahrte: Connect the cargo and the paid passages.
Verbinde Salzverlust und Reparatur im No: Connect the salt loss and the repair in the notebook.
Connect the trail of drops and the lab additive.
Compare the proof print and the memorial picture.
Vergleiche die Täfelchen oder beende die: Compare the tablets or end the search at the child's wish.
Vergleichsprobe im Salzwatt: Comparison sample on the salt flats
Verkauf erlauben und den Vorschuss nehme: Permit the sale and take the advance.
Versiegelter Lohn für eine geliehene Dec: Sealed payment for a borrowed blanket and a good word.
Versiegelter Lohn für unauffällige Nachr: Sealed payment for discreet messages at the sluice.
Versiegelter Lohn für warme Mahlzeiten w: Sealed payment for hot meals during Tinder's imprisonment.
Vollständiges Protokoll. Niemand soll de: A complete record. No one should keep the suspicion.
Warum fahren Boote ohne Licht durch dein: Why do boats pass through your sluice without lights?
Was hast du an Adas Gewichten repariert?: What did you repair on Ada's weights?
Wyle nimmt den versiegelten Behälter ent: Wyle takes the sealed container. As thanks, Jorin builds you a small washstand of clean glass, far from his lens salt.
Wyle vertraulich informieren und den Abf: Inform Wyle confidentially and secure the waste.
Wähle Entlastung oder einen bleibenden H: Choose relief from the hunt or a lasting helper.
Zieh die fehlerhafte Auflage ein. Wenige: Withdraw the faulty print. Less heat helps right now.
Ziviler Zeichner im Auftrag der Wache: Civilian draughtsman working for the watch
Zunder schiebt dir drei versiegelte Umsc:
Tinder pushes three sealed envelopes towards you. "Hesper cooked, Druce carried messages, Lamm pushed a blanket through the right door. I pay my own debts."

Outside a patrol whistles. "They're looking at every one of my visitors now. I'll give you twelve shillings for detours. Disguises cost less than explanations."
Zunder streicht drei Zeilen durch. „Jetz:
Tinder crosses out three lines. "Now I can turn up at theirs again without looking at my boots first."

A newly sealed peat stove waits by the bunk. "That replaces our draughty old stove either way. But the remaining twelve shillings: should I pay you for the trouble, or do we put them aside for the next favour?"
Zunder wirft die Münzen in eine Blechdos: Tinder tosses the coins into a tin. "Good. Then from now on the tin isn't called emergency money, it's called next time." The stove gets its first peat brick.
Zunder zählt dir den Lohn in die Hand. „: Tinder counts the wage into your hand. "Friendship doesn't make the way shorter. I know that." Then she pushes the stove into place.
Zur Nachbarin. Ich nehme den kleinen Arb: To the neighbour. I'll take the small wage.
Zurücklegen lassen. Das alte Büro soll n: Have it kept. The old office shouldn't vanish completely.
Zwei geflochtene Matten decken die zugig: Two woven mats cover the draughty hull wall next to the bunk.
Zweite Wartungsmarke im Salzwatt: Second maintenance marker on the salt flats
Zwischen Täfelchen für Linnet, Lio und L: Among the tablets for Linnet, Lio and Lin, only "Lin" has a yellow cord with three knots, just like on the sleeve.
„Du hast einmal zugehört. Darum schreibe:
"You listened once. That's why I'm writing. When your office was sealed, a brass cash box was still standing in the hallway. I took it to the pawnshop for safekeeping. Your old seal was with it.

You can redeem it later. If you need the money now, sign the sale permission on the back. I haven't read anything inside.

Ivy."

The postmark matches Hesper's conductor; the ink of the letter does not match your old seal.
„Ein Bahnpostschaffner, keine Geheimloge:
"A railway mail conductor, not a secret lodge," says Hesper. "He wasn't allowed to open the letter and still slid the pawn ticket under a jug. A remarkable selection of duties."

She points at the letter rack. "The sealed envelope is still there."
„Er wurde wegen einer ähnlichen Nase fes:
"He was arrested because of a similar nose. Afterwards it was a regrettable mix-up." Nils turns the picture over. "This nose can't take anything from a dead man any more."

"I can have the new print withdrawn as a misprint. Or I stay inconspicuous and write to you when the description changes."
